notablePrerequisites: Auntie Blyte does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion triggers.
In response, activate The Golden Throne by tapping it and sacrificing Volcano Hellion, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Volcano Hellion trigger, dealing any amount of damage to you and to any creature besides Auntie Blyte.
If your life total was reduced below 1, exile The Golden Throne and your life total becomes 1.
Auntie Blyte triggers, causing you to put a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the damage dealt.
Activate Auntie Blyte by paying {1}{R}, tapping them, and removing any number of +1/+1 counters from them, dealing that much damage to any target.
